title: anethum graveolens subsp. sowa
intro: Anethum graveolens subsp. sowa, commonly known as Indian dill or Sowa, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing relief from respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Indian dill include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Indian dill include carvone, limonene, and other compounds that contribute to its distinct aroma and medicinal effects.
